records.name: Georgia
records.note: no prison-housing data found. Wikipedia full-text search ('transgender prisoners Georgia prison placement') returned only US-dominant, jurisdiction-irrelevant hits. HRW World Report 2025 Georgia chapter (covers 2024) fetched and read: it documents the discriminatory Sept 2024 anti-LGBT law but contains no data on trans-prisoner housing — no birth-sex vs identity placement rule, no special unit, no solitary/segregation practice, no case or ruling. US State Dept 2023 HRR Georgia payload returned HTTP 403 (blocked; not retried per budget). No documentable source was located within budget; the record retains the prison-housing gap.
